sentences.text: Grid export is coordinated against the dispatch instructions, equipment capability, and the agreed operating limits for the connection.
Grid Dispatcher issues active-power targets and ramp instructions through the established dispatch channel.
Control Engineer reviews each instruction for consistency with current plant status before applying it.
SCADA Gateway provides the operational measurements used to track delivered power and instruction response.
Fleet Dispatch Console compares the requested output with available turbine capability and known operating restrictions.
The Shore Control Room maintains the current dispatch target, ramp rate, and next review time in the shift record.
Grid Interface Relay produces an Export Limit Advisory when available export capability falls below the active dispatch target.
Wildmere applies the accepted export ceiling to control outputs and records its effective time for audit.
Shore Control Room uses the tap snapshot to check the recorded transformer position during export reviews.
Control Engineer confirms that the control response follows the instruction and remains within the permitted ramp rate.
When a Grid Constraint is active, the operator records its scope, start time, and expected review point.
Turbine Controller adjusts output in accordance with validated plant commands and local equipment protections.
Converter Cabinet status is reviewed for alarms or restrictions that could affect export capability.
Offshore Substation operating status is included in the assessment of the available export path.
Main Transformer loading is monitored against its approved continuous and short-term limits.
Export Cable Monitor indications are checked for conditions that require a reduced transfer level.
Substation Operator coordinates switching activity that could alter the available export configuration.
Grid Dispatcher is notified when measured delivery differs materially from the instructed target or when an operating limit is approached.
Control Engineer records the reason for any temporary deviation from the requested output and the action taken.
Fleet Dispatch Console retains the instruction history and the corresponding plant response for later review.
If communications with the grid are interrupted, the Shore Control Room maintains the last validated operating limit while seeking clarification through the approved channel.
Emergency Generator operation is not treated as a means of maintaining export unless the approved electrical configuration explicitly supports it.
Duty Planner considers active dispatch constraints when scheduling work that would reduce generation or access to export equipment.
Shift records capture dispatch instructions, constraint decisions, measured response, and unresolved follow-up actions.
